w:r.w:t: Start Again Associates has an exceptional clinical team, a proprietary protocol, and 30 years of track record - but is essentially invisible online. With only 1 organic visitor per month and 2 ranking keywords across 31 crawled pages, the site is failing to connect its expertise with the clinicians and treatment centers who need it. The foundation is technically sound (SSL valid, sitemap present, desktop speed excellent), but the content, metadata, and mobile experience need a near-complete rebuild.

This is the most critical single issue on the site. The homepage has no content for Google to index and no message for visitors who land on it. In a YMYL (Your Money, Your Life) niche like mental health training, a blank homepage receives zero trust signals from Google quality raters. The result: Google does not know what the site is about, ranks it for nothing, and first-time visitors immediately bounce.
